summary: NTAG424 DNA is NXP's most advanced NFC sticker chip — combining AES-128 mutual authentication with Secure Dynamic Messaging (SDM) to generate a cryptographically unique URL on every tap, making tag cloning mathematically infeasible. The tamper-evident antenna loop permanently records when the tag is removed from its original surface. Used for product authentication, pharmaceutical serialization, luxury brand protection and wine/spirits anti-counterfeiting.
